definitions.explanation: The state of having no detectable odor. Used to describe products, substances, or environments.

examples.japanese: この{洗剤|せんざい}は{無臭|むしゅう}です。
{無色|むしょく}{無臭|むしゅう}の{気体|きたい}は{危険|きけん}なことがある。
examples.english: Colorless, odorless gases can be dangerous.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんがいるので、{無臭|むしゅう}タイプの{消臭剤|しょうしゅうざい}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: Since we have a baby, we use an unscented type of deodorizer.

notes:
USAGE:
{無臭|むしゅう} is a no-adjective ({無臭|むしゅう}の) or used as a standalone descriptor. It is composed of {無|む} (without) and {臭|しゅう} (smell). Commonly appears in product descriptions and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無色|むしょく}{無臭|むしゅう} (colorless and odorless)
- {無臭|むしゅう}タイプ (unscented type)
- {無臭|むしゅう}の{消臭剤|しょうしゅうざい} (odorless deodorizer)
- ほぼ{無臭|むしゅう} (almost odorless)
